algorithm: SolverFactory::Create(actual AnalysisStep), fixed Newmark beta=.25 gamma=.5; actual production AnalysisStep/Node/CR assembly and state transitions
override_qualification: Only this declared test parameter changes after factory creation; factory default minimumTimeStep=1e-5 is incompatible with the planned fine h. Production source and all other numerical parameters remain unchanged.
newton_qualification: Absolute production gate because external force is zero; nonlinear internal force scale is millions. The fixed value prevents a roundoff floor at unnecessarily tiny absolute force tolerance, while candidate accuracy remains checked independently.
normalization: Each of six q/v/a Y/RZ channels uses its maximum absolute value from the pre-candidate independent fine reference, frozen in reference.json. No production response is read to choose normalization or thresholds.
reference_method: Independent SciPy DOP853 with analytic force from the stated potential; rtol2.5e-13/maxstepThigh/128 and rtol5e-14/maxstepThigh/256 must agree before any production candidate
limitations: Reference derives the same two-DOF semidiscrete planar mechanical model; it is not a continuum spatial accuracy certificate.
No gyroscopic cross-axis coupling is present because all rotations share the principal Z axis; general spatial rotation and auxiliary Gauss history need separate cases.
The short two-high-frequency-period window is frozen for temporal order; it does not establish long-window slow-mode phase accuracy.
This derived finite-amplitude problem must not be presented as a published same-input transient reproduction.
